state.contract_text: This Agreement has an initial term of 12 months from the Effective Date and will automatically renew for successive 12-month terms unless either party provides written notice of non-renewal at least 60 days before the end of the then-current term. ... [full contract text] ...
state.cancellation_email_text: Hi team, we'd like to cancel our subscription and not renew for another year. Please confirm. Thanks, Jordan

has_auto_renewal.instructions: Does `contract_text` contain a clause under which the contract automatically renews for a further term unless one party gives notice?

criteria.true: the contract states it renews automatically absent notice of cancellation or non-renewal
criteria.false: the contract has no automatic renewal clause, or renewal requires an affirmative opt-in

is_cancellation_notice.instructions: Does `cancellation_email_text` unambiguously communicate the sender's intent to cancel the contract or not renew it, as opposed to e.g. a billing question, complaint, or request for information?

criteria.true: the email clearly states an intent to cancel or not renew
criteria.false: the email does not clearly state that intent

required_notice_band.instructions: Per the automatic-renewal clause in `contract_text`, how much advance notice (counted back from the renewal or expiration date of the then-current term) must a party give to prevent the contract from automatically renewing?

criteria.less_than_30_days: the required notice period is under 30 days
criteria.30_to_59_days: the required notice period is at least 30 and under 60 days
criteria.60_to_89_days: the required notice period is at least 60 and under 90 days
criteria.90_to_179_days: the required notice period is at least 90 and under 180 days
criteria.180_days_or_more: the required notice period is 180 days or more
criteria.not_specified_or_ambiguous: contract_text does not state a determinate notice period for non-renewal

notice_lead_time_band.instructions: `cancellation_email_text` was received on the date `cancellation_received_date` given in the state. Counting back from the renewal or expiration date of the then-current term stated in `contract_text`, how many days before that renewal date does `cancellation_received_date` fall?

criteria.on_or_after_renewal_date: cancellation_received_date is on or after the renewal/expiration date
criteria.less_than_30_days_before: cancellation_received_date is under 30 days before the renewal date
criteria.30_to_59_days_before: cancellation_received_date is at least 30 and under 60 days before the renewal date
criteria.60_to_89_days_before: cancellation_received_date is at least 60 and under 90 days before the renewal date
criteria.90_to_179_days_before: cancellation_received_date is at least 90 and under 180 days before the renewal date
criteria.180_days_or_more_before: cancellation_received_date is 180 or more days before the renewal date
criteria.renewal_date_not_determinable: contract_text does not give enough information to identify the current term's renewal/expiration date
